<multi_agent_role>You are an agent in a team of agents collaborating to complete a task.

You can spawn sub-agents to handle subtasks, and those sub-agents can spawn their own sub-agents. All agents in the team, including the agents that you can assign tasks to, are equally intelligent and capable, and have access to the same set of tools.

You can use `spawn_agent` to create a new agent, `followup_task` to give an existing agent a new task and trigger a turn, and `send_message` to pass a message to a running agent.
`send_message` calls may be read by a human, so ensure they are legible. Always put proper spaces between words and/or numbers.
Child agents can also spawn their own sub-agents.

When you provide a response in the final channel, that content is immediately delivered back to your parent agent.
In addition, your final answer may be read by a human, so ensure it is legible.

You will receive messages in the analysis channel in the form:
```
Message Type: NEW_TASK | MESSAGE | FINAL_ANSWER
Task name: <recipient>
Sender: <author>
Payload:
<payload text>
```
You may also see them addressed as to=/root/..., which indicates your identity is /root/...

Note that collaboration tools cannot be called from inside `functions.exec`. Call `spawn_agent`, `send_message`, `followup_task`, `wait_agent`, `interrupt_agent`, and `list_agents` only as direct tool calls using the recipient shown in their tool definitions, such as `to=functions.collaboration.spawn_agent`, since they are intentionally absent from the `functions.exec` `tools.*` namespace. Available tools in `functions.exec` are explicitly described with a `tools` namespace in the developer message.

All agents share the same directory. In detail:
- All agents have access to the same container and filesystem as you.
- All agents use the same current working directory.
- As a result, edits made by one agent are immediately visible to all other agents.

When calling `wait_agent`, prefer longer waits (minutes) to avoid busy polling.

There are 4 available concurrency slots, meaning that up to 4 agents can be active at once, including you.

Full-history forks (`fork_turns` omitted or `"all"`) inherit the parent model and reasoning effort and do not accept overrides. Only set `model` or `reasoning_effort` when explicitly requested by the user, applicable `AGENTS.md` instructions, or skill instructions; when doing so, set `fork_turns` to `"none"` or a positive integer string.</multi_agent_role>

raw : {};\n}\n\nasync function readLayout(ownerId: string): Promise<ProfileLayout> {\n  const { data, error } = await supabase.from(\"profiles\").select(\"class_id, layout_prefs\")\n    .eq(\"class_id\", ownerId).maybeSingle();\n  if (error) throw error;\n  if (!data || data.class_id !== ownerId) throw new Error(\"Your saved sidebar layout could not be verified.\");\n  return data;\n}\n\nasync function writeLayout(ownerId: string, before: ProfileLayout, next: RailPrefs): Promise<RailPrefs> {\n  const normalized = normalizeRailPrefs(next);\n  const payload = { ...layoutObject(before.layout_prefs), [RAIL_PREFS_KEY]: normalized } as unknown as Json;\n  // Match the entire previous layout so a second device cannot silently lose\n  // unrelated settings changed between this read and write.\n  const update = supabase.from(\"profiles\").update({ layout_prefs: payload }).eq(\"class_id\", ownerId);\n  const guarded = before.layout_prefs === null\n    ? 0) + 1, run_id: run.current }),\\r\\n      };\\r\\n      if (pending.current.user_id !== userId || pending.current.question_id !== questionId) throw new Error(\'Your pending answer belongs to a different account or question.\');\\r\\n      const savedAnswer = JSON.parse(pending.current.selected_answer) as { answer: string };\\r\\n      if (savedAnswer.answer !== answer || pending.current.correct !== correct) throw new Error(\'Retry the original pending answer before changing it.\');\\r\\n      await saveNativeLabSubmission(pending.current);\\r\\n      ordinals.current.set(questionId, (ordinals.current.get(questionId) ?? 0) + 1);\\r\\n      pending.current = null;\\r\\n      return true;\\r\\n    } catch {\\r\\n      setError(\'Your answer has not been confirmed in your account. Keep this page open and try saving again.\');\\r\\n      return false;\\r\\n    } finally { busy.current = false; setSaving(false); }\\r\\n  }\\r\\n  function restart() {\\r\\n    if (busy.current || pending.current) return false;\\r\\n    run.current = crypto.randomUUID(); ordinals.current.clear(); setError(null); return true;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n  return { save, restart, saving, error, blocked: saving || !!error };\\r\\n}\\r\\nimport { supabase } from \'@/integrations/supabase/client\';\\r\\nexport type NativeLabKind = \'main-conclusion\' | \'structure\' | \'conclusion-type\';\\r\\nexport interface NativeLabSubmission {\\r\\n  id: string; user_id: string; drill_id: string; question_id: string; mode: \'native_lab_v1\';\\r\\n  selected_answer: string; correct: boolean;\\r\\n}\\r\\nexport async function saveNativeLabSubmission(submission: NativeLabSubmission): Promise<void> {\\r\\n  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\\r\\n  if (authError) throw authError;\\r\\n  if (!user || user.id !== submission.user_id) throw new Error(\'The signed-in account changed. Your answer has not been saved.\');\\r\\n  const { data, error } = await supabase.from(\'intro_lr_attempts\').insert(submission).select(\'*\').single();\\r\\n  if (!error && data && matches(data, submission)) return;\\r\\n  // A response can be lost after the server inserts it. Reconcile the same UUID,\\r\\n  // never generate a replacement submission or modify an existing attempt.\\r\\n  const existing = await supabase.from(\'intro_lr_attempts\').select(\'*\').eq(\'user_id\', submission.user_id).eq(\'id\', submission.id).maybeSingle();\\r\\n  if (!existing.error && existing.data && matches(existing.data, submission)) return;\\r\\n  throw error ?? existing.error ?? new Error(\'The account did not acknowledge this saved answer.\');\\r\\n}\\r\\nfunction matches(row: Record<string, unknown>, expected: NativeLabSubmission): boolean {\\r\\n  return Object.entries(expected).every(([key, value]) => row[key] === value);\\r\\n}\\r\\nimport { supabase } from \'@/integrations/supabase/client\';\\r\\nimport { ORDERED_CANONICAL_MAIN_CONCLUSION_QUESTIONS, CANONICAL_REBUTTAL_VS_FIRST_STAGE_SETS } from \'@/bootcamps/main-conclusion/data/reference-drills/canonicalStructureQuestions\';\\r\\nimport { ORDERED_CANONICAL_CONCLUSION_TYPE_QUESTIONS } from \'@/bootcamps/main-conclusion/data/reference-drills/conclusionTypeQuestions\';\\r\\nimport type { NativeLabKind } from \'@/bootcamps/main-conclusion/lib/nativeLabAttempt\';\\r\\nimport type { ReviewQueueItem } from \'./reviewQueueModel\';\\r\\nimport type { IntroLrAttempt } from \'./introLrReviewSource\';\\r\\nconst uuid = \'[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}\';\\r\\nconst producer = new RegExp(`^native-lab:(main-conclusion|structure|conclusion-type):(${uuid})$`, \'i\');\\r\\nexport function nativeLabQuestion(kind: NativeLabKind, id: string) {\\r\\n  if (kind === \'conclusion-type\') {\\r\\n    const q = ORDERED_CANONICAL_CONCLUSION_TYPE_QUESTIONS.find(item => item.id === id);\\r\\n    return q ? { title: \'Conclusion Type Lab\', stimulus: q.stimulus, options: [\'recommendation\', \'causal\', \'prediction\', \'judgment\', \'rebuttal\'], answer: q.answer, explanation: q.explanation } : null;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n  const questions = kind === \'main-conclusion\' ? ORDERED_CANONICAL_MAIN_CONCLUSION_QUESTIONS : CANONICAL_REBUTTAL_VS_FIRST_STAGE_SETS.flatMap(stage => stage.questions);\\r\\n  const q = questions.find(item => item.id === id);\\r\\n  return q ? { title: kind === \'main-conclusion\' ? \'Main Conclusion Lab\' : \'First-Sentence vs Rebuttal Lab\', stimulus: q.stimulus,\\r\\n    options: kind === \'main-conclusion\' ? q.chunks : [\'first-sentence\', \'rebuttal\'],\\r\\n    answer: kind === \'main-conclusion\' ? String(q.correctMainConclusionIndex) : q.structureType === \'rebuttal\' ? \'rebuttal\' : \'first-sentence\',\\r\\n    explanation: q.revealExplanation || q.hint } : null;\\r\\n}\\r\\nexport function parseNativeLabAttempt(row: IntroLrAttempt, owner: string) {\\r\\n  const match = producer.exec(row.drill_id);\\r\\n  if (!match || row.mode !== \'native_lab_v1\') throw new Error(\'Unsupported native lab attempt.\');\\r\\n  const kind = match[1] as NativeLabKind;\\r\\n  const question = nativeLabQuestion(kind, row.question_id);\\r\\n  if (!question || row.user_id !== owner || !Number.isFinite(Date.parse(row.created_at))) throw new Error(\'Native lab attempt is unavailable.\');\\r\\n  let answer: unknown;\\r\\n  try { answer = JSON.parse(row.selected_answer ?? \'null\'); } catch { throw new Error(\'Invalid native lab saved answer.\'); }\\r\\n  if (!answer || typeof answer !== \'object\' || Array.isArray(answer)) throw new Error(\'Invalid native lab saved answer.\');\\r\\n  const payload = answer as Record<string, unknown>;\\r\\n  if (typeof payload.answer !== \'string\' || !Number.isSafeInteger(payload.ordinal) || Number(payload.ordinal) < 1 || payload.run_id !== match[2]) throw new Error(\'Invalid native lab submission identity.\');\\r\\n  const value = payload.answer;\\r\\n  if (kind === \'main-conclusion\' ? !/^(0|[1-9]\\\\d*)$/.test(value) || Number(value) >= question.options.length : !question.options.includes(value)) throw new Error(\'Invalid native lab choice.\');\\r\\n  return { row, kind, runId: match[2], question, answer: value, ordinal: Number(payload.ordinal) };\\r\\n}\\r\\nexport type NativeLabReviewAttempt = ReturnType<typeof parseNativeLabAttempt>;\\r\\nexport function nativeLabQueueItem(attempt: NativeLabReviewAttempt): ReviewQueueItem {\\r\\n  const answer = attempt.kind === \'main-conclusion\' ? attempt.question.options[Number(attempt.answer)] : attempt.answer;\\r\\n  return { key: `native-lab:${attempt.row.id}`, area: \'lr\', qid: attempt.row.question_id,\\r\\n    label: `${attempt.question.title} · ${attempt.row.question_id} · Submission ${attempt.ordinal}`,\\r\\n    qtype: attempt.question.title, reasons: [\'missed\'], sources: [\'native_lab_attempts\'], firstAnswer: attempt.ordinal === 1 ? answer : null,\\r\\n    latestAnswer: answer, correctAnswer: null, firstMissAt: attempt.row.created_at, lastActivityAt: attempt.row.created_at,\\r\\n    reflection: null, flaggedNote: null, href: `/review/native-lab/${encodeURIComponent(attempt.row.id)}` };\\r\\n}\\r\\nexport async function loadNativeLabReview(owner: string): Promise<ReviewQueueItem[]> {\\r\\n  const items: ReviewQueueItem[] = [];\\r\\n  for (let offset = 0; ; offset += 500) {\\r\\n    const { data, error } = await supabase.from(\'intro_lr_attempts\').select(\'*\').eq(\'user_id\', owner).eq(\'correct\', false)\\r\\n      .eq(\'mode\', \'native_lab_v1\').like(\'drill_id\', \'native-lab:%\').order(\'id\').range(offset, offset + 499);\\r\\n    if (error) throw error;\\r\\n    if (!Array.isArray(data)) throw new Error(\'Native lab saved attempts returned an invalid response.\');\\r\\n    items.push(...data.map(row => nativeLabQueueItem(parseNativeLabAttempt(row, owner))));\\r\\n    if (data.length < 500) return items;\\r\\n  }\\r\\n}\\r\\nexport async function fetchOwnedNativeLabAttempt(owner: string, id: string): Promise<NativeLabReviewAttempt | null> {\\r\\n  const { data, error } = await supabase.from(\'intro_lr_attempts\').select(\'*\').eq(\'user_id\', owner).eq(\'id\', id).eq(\'correct\', false).eq(\'mode\', \'native_lab_v1\').maybeSingle();\\r\\n  if (error) throw error;\\r\\n  return data ? parseNativeLabAttempt(data, owner) : null;\\r\\n}\\r\\nimport { useEffect, useState } from \'react\';\\r\\nimport { Link, useParams, useSearchParams } from \'react-router-dom\';\\r\\nimport { useAuth } from \'@/contexts/AuthContext\';\\r\\nimport { fetchOwnedNativeLabAttempt, type NativeLabReviewAttempt } from \'@/components/review/nativeLabReviewSource\';\\r\\nexport default function NativeLabReviewDetail() {\\r\\n  const { attemptId } = useParams(); const { user } = useAuth(); const [params] = useSearchParams();\\r\\n  const returnTo = params.get(\'returnTo\');\\r\\n  const back = returnTo?.split(\'?\')[0] === \'/review/to-review\' ? returnTo : \'/review/to-review?reason=missed\';\\r\\n  const scope = `${user?.id}:${attemptId}`;\\r\\n  const [saved, setSaved] = useState<{ scope: string; value: NativeLabReviewAttempt | null } | null>(null);\\r\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true); const [failed, setFailed] = useState(false); const [retry, setRetry] = useState(0);\\r\\n  useEffect(() => {\\r\\n    let active = true; setLoading(true); setFailed(false); setSaved(null);\\r\\n    if (!user?.id || !attemptId) { setLoading(false); return; }\\r\\n    void fetchOwnedNativeLabAttempt(user.id, attemptId).then(value => { if (active) setSaved({ scope, value }); })\\r\\n      .catch(() => { if (active) setFailed(true); }).finally(() => { if (active) setLoading(false); });\\r\\n    return () => { active = false; };\\r\\n  }, [user?.id, attemptId, scope, retry]);\\r\\n  const attempt = saved?.scope === scope ? saved.value : null;\\r\\n  return <main className=\\"mx-auto max-w-3xl space-y-5 px-4 py-7\\">\\r\\n    <Link to={back} className=\\"inline-flex min-h-11 items-center underline\\">Back to Review</Link>\\r\\n    {loading ? <p role=\\"status\\">Loading saved lab answer…</p> : failed ? <div role=\\"alert\\"><p>This saved lab answer could not be loaded.</p><button className=\\"min-h-11 underline\\" onClick={() => setRetry(value => value + 1)}>Try again</button></div>\\r\\n      : !attempt ? <p>This saved lab miss is unavailable in your account.</p> : <>\\r\\n        <h1 className=\\"text-2xl font-semibold\\">{attempt.question.title}</h1>\\r\\n        <p>{attempt.row.question_id} · Submission {attempt.ordinal} · {new Date(attempt.row.created_at).toLocaleDateString()}</p>\\r\\n        <section className=\\"space-y-3 rounded-xl border p-5\\"><h2 className=\\"text-lg font-semibold\\">The exercise</h2><p>{attempt.question.stimulus}</p><ol className=\\"space-y-2\\">{attempt.question.options.map((option, i) => <li key={i}>{attempt.kind === \'main-conclusion\' ? `${i + 1}. ` : \'\'}{option.replace(/<[^>]+>/g, \'\')}</li>)}</ol></section>\\r\\n        <section className=\\"space-y-3 rounded-xl border p-5\\"><h2 className=\\"text-lg font-semibold\\">Your saved answer</h2><p>{attempt.kind === \'main-conclusion\' ? attempt.question.options[Number(attempt.answer)].replace(/<[^>]+>/g, \'\') : attempt.answer}</p></section>\\r\\n        <section className=\\"space-y-3 rounded-xl border p-5\\"><h2 className=\\"text-lg font-semibold\\">How to reason through it</h2><p>{attempt.question.explanation}</p></section>\\r\\n        <p className=\\"text-sm text-muted-foreground\\">{attempt.ordinal === 1 ? Module progress instead waits\\r\\n *     for an exact account acknowledgement before updating the local cache.\\r\\n *   - On hydrate(), account rows are merged with local rows. A newer local\\r\\n *     practice session is preserved. '{"chunk_id":"81bed6","wall_time_seconds":0.308464,"exit_code":0,"original_token_count":1423,"output":"/**\\r\\n * Unified drill history — reads `public.drill_history`, the security-invoker\\r\\n * view that unions every per-question attempt source on the platform:\\r\\n *\\r\\n *   lr         → attempts (Smart Drill, type drills, guided drills, sections)\\r\\n *   intro-lr   → intro_lr_attempts (Main Conclusion bootcamp)\\r\\n *   rc         → rc_attempts (Reading Comprehension)\\r\\n *   abstract   → abstract_drill_attempts (Abstract Reasoning)\\r\\n *   causation  → cs_attempts (Causation Station)\\r\\n *\\r\\n * The view is not in the generated Supabase types yet, so rows are cast at\\r\\n * the call site — the established pattern in this repo for objects ahead of\\r\\n * a types regeneration.\\r\\n */\\r\\n\\r\\nimport { supabase } from \'@/integrations/supabase/client\';\\r\\n\\r\\nexport type DrillHistorySource = \'lr\' | \'intro-lr\' | \'rc\' | \'abstract\' | \'causation\';\\r\\n\\r\\nexport const SOURCE_LABELS: Record<DrillHistorySource, string> = {\\r\\n  lr: \'Drills\',\\r\\n  \'intro-lr\': \'Intro to LR\',\\r\\n  rc: \'Reading\',\\r\\n  abstract: \'Abstract\',\\r\\n  causation: \'Causation Station\',\\r\\n};\\r\\n\\r\\nexport interface DrillHistoryRow {\\r\\n  user_id: string;\\r\\n  source: DrillHistorySource;\\r\\n  question_key: string;\\r\\n  question_ref: string;\\r\\n  detail: string | null;\\r\\n  correct: boolean | null;\\r\\n  time_ms: number | null;\\r\\n  selected_answer: string | null;\\r\\n  mode: string | null;\\r\\n  attempted_at: string;\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\nexport interface QuestionRollup {\\r\\n  source: DrillHistorySource;\\r\\n  questionKey: string;\\r\\n  questionRef: string;\\r\\n  detail: string | null;\\r\\n  attempts: number;\\r\\n  gradedAttempts: number;\\r\\n  correctCount: number;\\r\\n  /** null when every attempt is ungraded (free-response work). */\\r\\n  accuracy: number | null;\\r\\n  avgTimeMs: number | null;\\r\\n  totalTimeMs: number;\\r\\n  lastCorrect: boolean | null;\\r\\n  lastAttemptedAt: string;\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\nconst PAGE_SIZE = 1000;\\r\\n\\r\\n/** Fetches the student\'s full attempt history, oldest data included. */\\r\\nexport async function fetchDrillHistory(userId: string): Promise<DrillHistoryRow[]> {\\r\\n  const rows: DrillHistoryRow[] = [];\\r\\n  let from = 0;\\r\\n  // Page through the whole history — a student with years of work should\\r\\n  // still see every attempt, not the newest thousand.\\r\\n  for (;;) {\\r\\n    const { data, error } = await supabase\\r\\n      .from(\'drill_history\' as never)\\r\\n      .select(\'*\')\\r\\n      .eq(\'user_id\', userId)\\r\\n      .order(\'attempted_at\', { ascending: false })\\r\\n      .range(from, from + PAGE_SIZE - 1);\\r\\n    if (error) throw new Error(error.message ?? \'Could not load drill history\');\\r\\n    const batch = (data ?? [{'type': 'input_text', 'text': 'Script completed\nWall time 0.7 seconds\nOutput:\n'}, {'type': 'input_text', 'text': '{"chunk_id":"5351e0","wall_time_seconds":0.4820669,"exit_code":0,"original_token_count":1092,"output":"/**\\r\\n * Sat sections — reading `section_history` back out.\\r\\n *\\r\\n * The table has been written since the first full section shipped and, until\\r\\n * now, read by exactly two things: the dashboard\'s last-five widget and the\\r\\n * practice-test scorer. No page ever showed a student the sections they had\\r\\n * sat. A section was a screen you got once, at the moment you finished, and\\r\\n * never again.\\r\\n *\\r\\n * This is the reader. A sat section becomes an object with a history: a score,\\r\\n * a blind review or the honest absence of one, timing, and — for rows written\\r\\n * after `questions_json` started being persisted — the question-by-question\\r\\n * record behind the totals.\\r\\n *\\r\\n * Rows written before that carry `questions_json: []`. They are not broken and\\r\\n * they are not empty sections; the detail simply was not kept. {@link hasDetail}\\r\\n * is the distinction, so the UI can say so rather than render a blank table.\\r\\n */\\r\\n\\r\\nimport { supabase } from \'@/integrations/supabase/client\';\\r\\nimport type { SectionQuestionStat } from \'@/lib/sectionHistorySave\';\\r\\nimport type { SectionAnalysis } from \'@/lib/sectionAnalysis\';\\r\\n\\r\\nexport interface SectionHistoryRow {\\r\\n  id: string;\\r\\n  practiceTestRunId: string | null;\\r\\n  pt: number;\\r\\n  section: number;\\r\\n  mode: string | null;\\r\\n  initialScore: number;\\r\\n  initialTotal: number;\\r\\n  initialPercent: number;\\r\\n  /** null when no blind review was sat. Never 0 — that would be a review scored. */\\r\\n  brScore: number | null;\\r\\n  brPercent: number | null;\\r\\n  brDelta: number | null;\\r\\n  brUsed: boolean;\\r\\n  totalTimeMs: number;\\r\\n  avgTimeMs: number;\\r\\n  unansweredCount: number;\\r\\n  byQtype: Record<string, { correct: number; total: number }>;\\r\\n  byDifficulty: Record<string, { correct: number; total: number }>;\\r\\n  /** Empty for sections sat before the per-question record was persisted. */\\r\\n  questions: SectionQuestionStat[];\\r\\n  /**\\r\\n   * The diagnosis written at completion. Null for sittings from before the\\r\\n   * engine existed, which must render as \\"no report\\" rather than as an empty\\r\\n   * one — an empty report reads as \\"nothing was wrong\\".\\r\\n   */\\r\\n  analysis: SectionAnalysis | null;\\r\\n  completedAt: string;\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n/** Did this row keep its question-by-question record? */\\r\\nexport const hasDetail = (row: SectionHistoryRow): boolean => row.questions.length > 0;\\r\\n\\r\\n/** `PT105.S2`, the label 7Sage uses and the one that reads fastest. */\\r\\nexport const sectionLabel = (row: SectionHistoryRow): string =>\\r\\n  `PT${row.pt}.S${row.section}`;\\r\\n\\r\\nconst asTally = (v: unknown): Record<string, { correct: number; total: number }> =>\\r\\n  v && typeof v === \'object\' && !Array.isArray(v)\\r\\n    ? (v as Record<string, { correct: number; total: number }>)\\r\\n    : {};\\r\\n\\r\\nconst asQuestions = (v: unknown): SectionQuestionStat[] =>\\r\\n  Array.isArray(v) ? (v as SectionQuestionStat[]) : [];\\r\\n\\r\\n/**\\r\\n * Every section this student has sat, newest first.\\r\\n *\\r\\n * Filtered on `user_id` rather than `class_id`: the row carries both, and the\\r\\n * question \\"which sections have I sat\\" is about the person, not the class they\\r\\n * happened to be in at the time.\\r\\n */\\r\\nexport async function fetchSectionHistory(\\r\\n  userId: string,\\r\\n): Promise<SectionHistoryRow[]> {\\r\\n  return fetchSectionHistoryBy(\'user_id\', userId);\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n/**\\r\\n * The same list, addressed by class rather than by user.\\r\\n *\\r\\n * The teacher workspace knows a student by their class_id — it is what the\\r\\n * roster, the classroom items and every assignment are keyed on — and has no\\r\\n * reason to hold their auth user id. Reading these rows at all depends on the\\r\\n * admin SELECT policy; without it this returns an empty list rather than an\\r\\n * error, which is why the teacher surface must never render an empty result\\r\\n * as \\"this student has done nothing\\".\\r\\n */\\r\\nexport async function fetchSectionHistoryByClass(\\r\\n  classId: string,\\r\\n): Promise<SectionHistoryRow[]> {\\r\\n  return fetchSectionHistoryBy(\'class_id\', classId);\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n/** Load one completed section for its owning account, including saved question outcomes. */\\r\\nexport async function fetchOwnedSectionHistoryItem(\\r\\n  userId: string,\\r\\n  historyId: string,\\r\\n): Promise<SectionHistoryRow | null> {\\r\\n  const { data, error } = await supabase\\r\\n    .from(\'section_history\')\\r\\n    .select(\'*\')\\r\\n    .eq(\'id\', historyId)\\r\\n    .eq(\'user_id\', userId)\\r\\n    .is(\'practice_test_run_id\', null)\\r\\n    .maybeSingle();\\r\\n  if (error) throw error;\\r\\n"}'}]

A preview is a read; it gets no row.\\r\\n */\\r\\nfunction previewAssignment(activity: Activity, userId: string): ActivityAssignment {\\r\\n  return {\\r\\n    id: `preview:${activity.id}`,\\r\\n    activity_id: activity.id,\\r\\n    student_id: userId,\\r\\n    title: activity.title,\\r\\n    subtitle: activity.subtitle,\\r\\n    instructions: activity.instructions,\\r\\n    item_format: activity.item_format,\\r\\n    /*\\r\\n     * Section mode is carried by three fields, and a preview that drops them\\r\\n     * silently runs the WRONG PLAYER. `ActivityRunner` picks the section runner\\r\\n     * on `mode === \\"section\\"`; without it the branch falls through to the v1\\r\\n     * chunk-by-chunk runner, which judges live, accepts typing and walks a\\r\\n     * cursor -- every one of which section mode forbids. e.message : \\"Failed to load activities\\");\\r\\n      setAssignments([]);\\r\\n    } finally {\\r\\n      setLoading(false);\\r\\n    }\\r\\n  }, [user]);\\r\\n\\r\\n  useEffect(() => {\\r\\n    if (user) void refresh();\\r\\n  }, [user, refresh]);\\r\\n\\r\\n  return { assignments, loading, error, refresh };\\r\\n}\\r\\n\\r\\n/** Student-side single activity assignment. */\\r\\nexport function useStudentActivity(\\r\\n  assignmentId: string | undefined,\\r\\n  previewActivityId?: string,\\r\\n) {\\r\\n  const { user } = useAuth();\\r\\n  const [assignment, setAssignment] = useState<ActivityAssignment | null>(null);\\r\\n  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);\\r\\n  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);\\r\\n\\r\\n  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {\\r\\n    if (!user || (!assignmentId && !previewActivityId)) return;\\r\\n    setLoading(true);\\r\\n    try {\\r\\n      if (previewActivityId) {\\r\\n        const activity = await getActivity(previewActivityId);\\r\\n        setAssignment(activity ? No dedicated Activity assignment RPC was found. The supported silent fixture path is a direct `activity_assignments` insert under an authenticated admin:

- `assigned_by`: actual teacher actor.
- `student_id` and `class_id`: designated tester.
- `activity_id`: existing live Spot the Relationship definition.
- Preserve its title, subtitle, instructions, format, mode and timing fields.
- Snapshot only exact authored item 1 into `items`.
- Start with `status: assigned`, no score or completion timestamp.

The admin INSERT policy requires `assigned_by = auth.uid()`. An existing active assignment for the same student/activity may block insertion; preserve it rather than modifying it.

Teacher Work reads these assignments directly, so a classroom notification is unnecessary. Underlying `assignWork({notify:false})` can suppress notifications, but copies the entire Activity, so it cannot produce this one-item fixture. The UI assignment hook always notifies.

Verify live policies/constraints first. No files or records changed.

## assistant

Read-only inventory found 13 chat functions routed through `gemini-proxy`:

| Function | Purpose / app entry |
|---|---|
| `activity-coach` | Activity free-text grading, **Submit** |
| `analyze-stem-response` | Stem translation grading; no current frontend caller found |
| `grade-rrc-section` | Recorded Activity section grading, completion/report |
| `motivation-engine` | Motivation generation; no current frontend caller found |
| `parse-drill-request` | Natural Drill Creator |
| `parse-external-work` | Uploaded work parsing; automatic upload and teacher retry |
| `polish-message` | Inbox and teacher desk message polishing |
| `study-chat` | Student study chat |
| `synthesize-session-bundle` | Teacher session synthesis |
| `ta-chat` | Selected-student teacher assistant |
| `teacher-operator-chat` | Teacher operator chat and tools |
| `tutor-chat` | Drill question tutoring/explanation generation |
| `voice-coach-respond` | Voice coaching modal |

All currently request legacy `gemini-3.8-flash` except RRC grading, which requests `google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite`. **The proxy ignores every requested chat model and forces `google/gemini-3.1-flash-lite`.** Embeddings similarly force `google/gemini-embedding-001`, explicitly 3072 dimensions. Embedding callers are knowledge ingestion/retrieval, teacher link search, and operator retrieval.

Bypasses:

- `ta-agent`: directly uses Lovable Gateway; environment model override, default Flash Lite.
- `inspect`: directly prefers Google when its key exists, otherwise Lovable Gateway; Flash Lite.
- RRC grader: proxy first, direct Google Flash Lite fallback after gateway failure.
- RRC transcription separately uses Deepgram Nova 3.

Highest-priority diligence gaps:

1. **False model provenance.** Tutor explanation records/cache label `gemini-3.8-flash`, while the actual model is Flash Lite. Operator model selection and synthesis environment overrides are also ineffective through the proxy.
2. **No central budget or deadline.** Proxy has no input byte/token ceiling, output ceiling, timeout, per-user spend quota, or usage ledger. Activity coach alone sets `max_tokens:220`; most callers omit output limits.
3. **Large context allowance.** Operator permits 50 messages × 20,000 characters plus four images; study chat permits 100 messages without visible per-message size bounds. Neither establishes a total token budget.
4. **Grading authority needs evaluation.** Free-text verdicts and RRC grades depend on Flash Lite judgments, but model changes lack a verified grading benchmark in this inventory.
5. **Repeated avoidable paid calls.** Spot the Relationship has no local matching path, even for authored credited answers. Its 48-item assignment therefore potentially makes at least 48 AI calls. Conditional Rephrase already demonstrates a local authoritative path.
6. **Timeout does not guarantee spend stops.** Activity UI aborts after 12 seconds, while backend/proxy fetches have no matching cancellation deadline.

Existing bounds include: synthesis transcript 60,000 characters; voice transcript 5,000 and stimulus 10,000; drill request 500; message polish 5,000 plus 500 instruction characters; TA message 10,000; Inspector 14 tool iterations; Operator four iterations; tutor history last 20 turns; knowledge retrieval query 500 and 8 student/15 admin matches.

This confirms checked-in routing, not deployed function parity or provider limits. No application files changed. One accidental scratch file was created at `C:/Users/Joshu/dev/ai-os/.tmp-ai-route-audit.txt`; root was notified for cleanup.

## assistant

There is one production caller: `ActivityRunner → ActivityQuestionStack → ActivityItemView → useActivityCoach → activity-coach`. No alternate invokes or Hard Sentences callers were found.

The request currently carries **client-supplied** prompt, credited answers, explanation, category, rubric, response text and attempt number. It carries **no assignment ID or item order**, so authenticated users can replace the grading source.

Trusted source fields already exist:

- `activity_assignments.items`: exact issued item snapshot with `order`, `prompt`, `credited_answers`, `explanation`, optional `category`.
- `activity_assignments.instructions.coach`: issued rubric snapshot.
- Assignment owner, teacher actor, status and revocation metadata.
- `activity_item_responses`: assignment, student, item order, attempt number and submitted response.

Attempt numbering is currently local `attempts + 1`, restored from saved responses; cap is two. Reveal writes a cap-reaching response. Coach failure records an unjudged response.

Press coverage is currently unwired: its ideas are derived from authored explanation by `parsePress`, but `ActivityItemView` never supplies `ideas` to the hook, and the world does not receive returned coverage. Hard Sentences uses its separate saved source flow.

Recommended compatible rollout:

1. Add a versioned grading contract accepting assignment ID, item order, response text and stable request UUID. Read exact issued source server-side under authenticated ownership; reject revoked, abandoned or unavailable work.
2. Preserve assigned-item access even without the global Activity entitlement. Existing `AssignmentGate` deliberately allows ownership OR feature access. Do not replace this with a global flag requirement.
3. Handle teacher preview and completed practice separately as explicitly unrecorded grading modes. Teacher preview uses authored definition identity; teachers viewing student assignments must not write responses.
4. Derive rubric and Press checklist from server source. Ignore client-authored grading fields.
5. Retain exact request receipts and validate numbering server-side. Ambiguous retries must return the same judgment, not spend another call.
6. Persist the accepted judgment server-side. Source-bound grading alone leaves forged client verdict inserts possible.
7. Expose capability/version before frontend adoption; keep legacy endpoints until every real caller migrates, then reject unsigned legacy grading requests.

Existing revocation SQL binds inserted responses to exact assignment ownership and rejects revoked sources. It does not establish trusted AI verdict provenance.

No files, records or AI calls changed.

|| !source || ![\"assignment\", \"preview\"].includes(source.sourceKind) || !uuid.test(source.sourceId) || !Number.isSafeInteger(itemOrder) || itemOrder < 1 || ![1, 2].includes(attemptNo) || !studentResponse.trim() || studentResponse.length > 10000) throw new Error(\"This Activity grading source is unavailable.\");\n  const identity = { actor, ...source, itemOrder, studentResponse, const verified = storage.getItem(key);\n  if (verified !== JSON.stringify({ identity, requestId })) throw new Error(\"The grading request could not be saved on this device.\");\n  return { \"../api/types\";\nimport { retainCoachRequest, type CoachSource } from \"./activityCoachRequest\";\nexport interface JudgeArgs { item: ActivityItem; studentResponse: string; attemptNo: number; source?: CoachSource }\nexport interface JudgeResult { ok: boolean; verdict?: CoachVerdict; error?: string; discarded?: boolean }\nconst COACH_TIMEOUT_MS = 12_000;\nexport function useActivityCoach() {\n  const { user } = useAuth();\n  const actor = user?.id;\n  const scope = useRef(actor); scope.current = actor;\n  const [busyActor, setBusyActor] = useState<string | null>(null);\n  const judge = useCallback(async ({ item, studentResponse, attemptNo, source }: JudgeArgs): Promise<JudgeResult> => {\n    if (!actor || !source) return { ok: false, error: \"This Activity grading source is unavailable.\" };\n    const current = () => scope.current === actor;\n    setBusyActor(actor);\n    const abort = new AbortController();\n    const timeout = setTimeout(() => abort.abort(), COACH_TIMEOUT_MS);\n    try {\n      const auth = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n      if (!current() || auth.error || auth.data.user?.id !== actor) return { ok: false, discarded: true, error: \"The signed-in account changed.\" };\n      let body;\n      try { body = retainCoachRequest(actor, source, item.order, studentResponse, attemptNo); }\n      catch { return { ok: false, error: \"Could not retain this grading request on your device. No Coach call was made.\" }; }\n      if (!current()) return { ok: false, discarded: true };\n      const { data, error } = await supabase.functions.invoke(\"activity-coach\", { signal: abort.signal, body });\n      const after = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n      if (!current() || after.error || after.data.user?.id !== actor) return { ok: false, discarded: true, error: \"The signed-in account changed.\" };\n      if (error) return { ok: false, error: \"Coach could not confirm this request. Its saved identity is kept for retry.\" };\n      if (!data || ![\"correct\", \"partial\", \"incorrect\"].includes(data.verdict) || typeof data.feedback !== \"string\" || !data.feedback.trim()) return { ok: false, error: \"Coach returned no verified judgment.\" };\n      const covered = Array.isArray(data.covered) ? data.covered.filter((n: unknown) => typeof n === \"number\" && Number.isFinite(n)) : undefined;\n      return { ok: true, verdict: { verdict: data.verdict, feedback: data.feedback, covered } };\n    } catch {\n      if (!current()) return { ok: false, discarded: true };\n      return { ok: false, error: abort.signal.aborted ? \"Coach timed out. Its saved request identity is kept for retry.\" : \"Coach unavailable. Its saved request identity is kept for retry.\" };\n    } finally { clearTimeout(timeout); if (current()) setBusyActor(null); }\n  }, [actor]);\n  return { judge, judging: Boolean(actor && busyActor === actor) };\n}\n''')\nfor file in ['ActivityItemView.tsx','ActivityQuestionStack.tsx']:\n p=Path('src/features/activity-centre/components')/file;s=p.read_text();s='import type { CoachSource } from \"../hooks/activityCoachRequest\";\\n'+s;s=s.replace('  coach?: ActivityCoach;', '  coach?: ActivityCoach;\\n  coachSource?: CoachSource;');s=s.replace('  coach,\\n', '  coach,\\n  coachSource,\\n');s=s.replace('coach={coach}', 'coach={coach}\\n            coachSource={coachSource}');s=s.replace('attemptNo, coach });','attemptNo, source: coachSource });\\n    if (res.discarded) return;');p.write_text(s)\np=Path('src/features/activity-centre/components/ActivityRunner.tsx');s=p.read_text();s=s.replace('coach={assignment.instructions?.coach}', 'coach={assignment.instructions?.coach}\\n            coachSource={preview && previewActivityId ? { sourceKind: \"preview\", sourceId: previewActivityId } : !preview ? { sourceKind: \"assignment\", sourceId: assignment.id } : undefined}');p.write_text(s)\n'@ | python -",workdir:"C:/Users/Joshu/dev/lsatu-ai-grading-integrity",login:false}));
